class.name: SteamRemotePlayInputEvent
class.brief_description: A detached Steam keyboard or mouse event identified by its stream.
class.description: Consume this sample in the matching local seat. Crimson leaves global Godot input routing to the game.

members.member: Godot keyboard, mouse motion, mouse button, or wheel event. Relative motion stays in the units reported by Steam. Map normalized absolute motion to the intended viewport before dispatching to a UI. Button and wheel samples carry no pointer position.

Whether a mouse motion event also has a [member InputEventMouse.position] normalized to the host window. Values range from 0 to 1 in each dimension. False for relative-only motion and all other samples.
Stream ID of the sender. Route the sample to that stream's local seat.
